**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/10 (Wed) 20:46
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are many up and coming natural wines that are gaining popularity among wine enthusiasts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pétillant-Naturel (Pét-Nat) Wines are sparkling wines that are bottled before primary fermentation is complete, resulting in a lightly carbonated and slightly cloudy wine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable examples of Pét-Nat wines include:
  - Michael Cruse, Monkey Jacket, Valdiguié, North Coast, California, USA
  - La Grange Tiphaine, Nouveau-Nez, Chenin Blanc, Loire Valley, France
  - Christophe Pacalet, Pétillant Naturel, Gamay, Beaujolais, France
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Greece has a long history of winemaking, but its natural wine scene is relatively new and still emerging.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Exciting natural wines from Greece include:
  - Lyrarakis, Plyto, Crete, Greece
  - Markovitis, Ancestral Tradition, Limnio, Thessaly, Greece
  - Troupis, Fteri Moschofilero, Arcadia, Greece
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hungary is embracing natural and biodynamic practices in winemaking.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable natural wines from Hungary include:
  - Meinklang, Foam Cuvée, Hárslevelü, Burgenland, Austria (made with grapes from the Hungarian side of the border)
  - Wetzer, Kékfrankos, Sopron, Hungary
  - Fekete Béla, Juhfark, Somló, Hungary
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] South Africa's natural wine scene is gaining attention for its unique and expressive wines.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Exciting natural wines from South Africa include:
  - Testalonga, El Bandito, Chenin Blanc, Swartland, South Africa
  - Jurgen Gouws, Nativo, Cinsault, Stellenbosch, South Africa
  - The Blacksmith Wines, The Blood of Jove, Syrah, Swartland, South Africa
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These are just a few examples of the many exciting natural wines that are emerging from around the world.
- [USER] Can you add some sake to the wine list?
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Here are some sake options that could be added to the wine list:
  - Junmai: Pure rice sake made without the addition of distilled alcohol. Good options include:
    - Dassai 39 Junmai Daiginjo, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan
